archetype: Organic & Earthy + Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted for Medical Serenity)
aesthetic_inspiration: Mother Teresa habit (White with pure blue trim), Apple Health, Withings Health Mate
core_principles: Generous white space to convey cleanliness and clarity
Soft, confident blue accents over stark white surfaces
Large, legible typographic hierarchy for medical data
Accessible and highly discernible status colors

typography.instructions: Use React Native's default 'System' font for iOS San Francisco and Android Roboto to maintain platform-native premium health app familiarity. Do not use custom fonts unless absolutely required.

camera_cta.ring_chart_wrapper: Wrap CTA in a circular SVG progress indicator representing healing percentage

Global.TopBar: Sticky header. Hamburger on left. T.E.R.E.S.A. text/logo centered. Bell icon (with red dot absolute positioned for alerts) on right. Background #FFFFFF, zIndex high, soft bottom border/shadow.
Global.BottomTabs: SafeArea handled. Icons for Home, Calendar, Alerts, Profile. Active tint #2D6CDF, inactive tint #94A3B8. Background #FFFFFF.

Login.layout: Minimalist. Centered app logo/name. Email and password inputs (border #E2E8F0, focus #2D6CDF). Large Primary 'Entrar' button. White background.

sections: Environmental Cards: Row of two cards (Temp & Humidity). Large metric numbers (metric_large typography).
Chart Card: Line chart for Temperature. Top right segmented control (24h | 7d | 30d). Smooth bezier curve line chart with gradient fill below line.
Primary Action: Centered large Circular Camera button with pulsing animation and healing percentage SVG ring chart around it.
Quick Alerts: Small card list below camera.
Quick Contacts: Horizontal scroll of rounded cards with doctor/nurse avatars and a phone icon CTA.

elements: Live status indicator at top (Green/Red dot + text).
Step-by-step instructions (1-9) in a vertical timeline format.
List of found BLE devices as modern cards with 'Connect' buttons.

Calendar.indicators: Dots under dates. Blue (Session Done), Green (Good Progress), Yellow (Observation), Red (Alert).
Calendar.day_detail: Card below calendar showing selected date details: Temp/Humidity average, session duration, photos grid, mini trend chart.

Notices.card_structure: Left: Status Icon (color-coded). Middle: Title (bold) + Description (body) + Timestamp (caption). Status badge on right.

Profile.patient_view: Avatar, Name, Age. Treatment Summary cards. Healing progress gauge. Photo history grid.
Profile.doctor_view: Avatar, Name, CRM, Specialty. Search bar. List of patients to switch active context.

WoundAnalysis.elements: Captured photo at top with subtle overlay mask. Data points below: Estimated Area, Predominant Color, Inflammation level, Granulation, Time Remaining. Large overall Healing % gauge at bottom.

testing_rules.instructions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'testID' attribute (React Native equivalent of data-testid). Use kebab-case, role-based names (e.g., testID='login-submit-button').
